ns2:section.sectionText: Not intended for students with freshmen standing. Lab hours include assisting in preschool classroom 4 hours per week, including lesson planning and implementation, guidance practice, and guided experience with a portfolio informal assessment tool. There will be important weekly individual meetings set up with lab instructor once classes start. Registration by non-HDFS majors requires instructor permission. Contact Dr. Linlin Yao at lyao@illinois.edu.
